typical_symptoms: Mottled appearance on the youngest leaves showing alternating patches of green and light green or yellowish tissue
Elongated chlorotic stripes or streaks running parallel to the leaf veins
Stunting of the entire plant in severe infections
Occasional mild necrosis in older chlorotic areas
visual_characteristics: Irregular light and dark green patches creating a mosaic or checkerboard pattern
Prominent striping parallel to the main vein
Greater chlorosis near the base of young expanding leaves
lesion_characteristics: Elongated patches or streaks following the leaf veins without defined necrotic borders or halos
color_characteristics: Alternating shades of normal green, light green, pale yellow, and yellowish-white in a mottled distribution
texture_characteristics: Smooth normal leaf texture with no pustules, raised scabs, or water-soaking
spatial_patterns: Mottled patches and streak patterns running longitudinally parallel to the leaf veins
distinguishing_features: Interspersed light and dark green patches forming a true mosaic pattern without discrete spots, pustules, or heavy necrosis
